cases.scenario: After a successful sync, add an ignore rule for one current file and sync once.
cases.expected: The ignored source becomes non-current while its historical SourceVersion remains.

cases.scenario: Place a directory symlink to an external directory below the imported root.
cases.expected: No source below the symlink target is read, returned, or stored.

cases.scenario: Update readable text in one saved HTML file and sync once.
cases.expected: The source ID remains stable and exactly one new current SourceVersion is created.
